prompt: A cinematic film still captures a bustling shipyard dock under overcast skies. On the left, a welder in blue coveralls stands firmly beside a rusted anchor chain. In the center foreground, a foreman in a yellow hard hat points decisively toward the horizon while holding a rolled blueprint. Next to him, an engineer in a gray vest looks at the same distant point with intense focus. To the right, a crane operator in orange gear sits on a wooden crate, wiping sweat from his brow with a ragged cloth. Behind the crane operator, a stray brown dog rests its head on its paws, watching the scene unfold. A large cargo container painted faded red dominates the mid-ground, casting a long shadow across the wet concrete. Leaning against this container is a tired sailor in a striped shirt, clutching a metal thermos. Above them, a seagull perches precariously on a steel beam, observing the workers below. Near the water's edge, a small fishing boat bobs gently, tied securely by thick ropes. Finally, a stack of tires lies discarded near the foreground, partially obscured by mist. The welder hands a wrench to the sailor, who reaches out to accept it. The foreman gestures toward the crane operator, signaling a pause in work. The engineer stands next to the foreman, sharing the moment of observation. The brown dog lies next to the wooden crate, close to the seated operator. There is no sunlight breaking through the clouds. There is no visible water pollution or oil slicks on the surface.
